notes: Candidate inventory; per-artifact review fields govern staging. On 2026-10-14 the official MoCo v2/v3 endpoints returned HTTP 200 with identity-encoding Content-Length values 112133139 and 272786643. Earlier expected_bytes were 1121331339 and 2727866643: approximately, but not exactly, 10x the observed sizes. The exact 10x values would be 1121331390 and 2727866430, so the earlier entries differ by -51 and +213 bytes, respectively; each had one extra repeated digit. The corrected sizes match completed transfer byte counts. MoCo v2's ETag starts with the published MD5 prefix a04e12f8; MoCo v3's multipart ETag is not a digest. Complete downloads still require exact-length checks and recorded local SHA-256; size metadata alone does not establish checkpoint integrity. No upstream SHA-256 is published for these artifacts; complete-transfer local SHA-256 values are recorded in the evidence JSON and cluster receipts. SLED and TriDerm do not require public weights. Adapter 3 prepares an origin-specific TensorFlow SAME pooling profile for SimCLR; five new spatial checks passed locally on CPU; the alternate Hugging Face PyTorch source was downloaded and strictly converted locally. Syntax alone does not validate real tensors or upstream numerical equivalence. Legacy MoCo/DINO conversion receipts remain pinned to adapter 2 and their original source manifest.
